# Public source and resource provenance

Primary source: https://en3.live/ — public pages, organisation pages, journal, policies, public stylesheets and public images, captured 25 October 2026. Original asset URLs are retained in asset-manifest.csv and capture-report.json.

Visual reference: the user's existing Champ/sites/chande-recreation project, read without modifying it. Only three font resources are copied; the new layout is authored here. No Chande attendee photographs, registration records, or 3D runtime are included.

The reference HTML files are rendered public output, not the original Next.js source repository. The editable implementation in this new project is static HTML/CSS/JavaScript. The original live application's private business logic cannot be reconstructed from public page captures.

Image assets come from EN3's publicly served media. Preserve the original owner's asset permissions and attribution when using them outside this development project. No unrelated paid image libraries or additional subscriptions were added.

One generated CSS fragment reference (#n) was reported as a failed fetch by the capture helper; it is an internal SVG fragment, not a missing visual asset. It is ignored in local asset checks.
